name: Lamech
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: “And Lamech took unto him two wives”: the first time you read about polygamy is here, in Cain’s kids. “The name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.”

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: “And Lamech took unto him two wives”. Keep that name Lamech in mind: Enoch had Lamech, on Cain’s line. These are Cainites, the wicked. The name of the one was Adah, wife one; the name of the other Zillah, wife two.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Lamech boasted that he slew a young man to his hurt, and if Cain is avenged sevenfold, Lamech seventy and sevenfold. Murder became normal and celebrated.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

points: It’s not Tubal–cain speaking here. This Lamech is Tubal–cain’s father, and he is telling his wives, I killed someone.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Lamech, of Cain's line, boasted to his wives: I have slain a man to my wounding. If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold. There it is: 70 times 7 in the mouth of a murderer means complete, total, utter vengeance.

note.label: 70 Times 7: The Perfection of Mercy Through Christ

points: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold. They did not just kill the one man that hurt Lamech; they wiped out that whole lineage. That is how Esau gets down; remember who their desire was to.
Lamech knew the commandment thou shalt not kill was in force in his day; that is why he appealed to Cain's sevenfold, saying seventy and sevenfold. They knew the commandments during that time.

note.label: Genesis 4: Cain, Abel, and the Sons of the Wicked

points: In verse 23 Lamech just killed a man with one of his son’s weapons, and now he says, if anyone tries to kill me: “If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.” So Lamech fathered a son of destruction. Enoch had Lamech, Lamech had Tubal–cain.

What is this saying? Anybody that takes vengeance on Lamech, they going to go and wipe out that whole family lineage. That’s how Esau was rolling. They going to come and kill that whole city, the whole village, and they are able to do it because of the weaponry the evil angels gave them power to create. The father is saying, this dude gave me a weapon, that thing was so bad I killed this young dude: the young man was young and strong, and he was able to kill him with the weapon his son gave him. In the beginning nobody could have messed with Cain’s lineage. You mess with Cain and his lineage, they coming for you and they killing you and your whole family.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End
